conceptLabel: AI option 01 - cyan industrial altitude gauge rails
layerMethod: Pure Node raster extraction from flattened gear-source.png: manual gauge bounding boxes, RGB hue/saturation pixel masks, blur-expanded alpha for immediate gauge glow, local dark-rail sampling for base neutralization, and conservative non-gauge saturated-light extraction outside padded gauge boxes.
caveats: Source is a flattened generated bitmap, so gauge removal is approximate rather than true inpainting.
gear-base.png strongly neutralizes bright gauge cells/tubes and nearby glow; faint rail ghosts or softened separators may remain where the source had no clean background pixels.
gear-glow.png is conservative and excludes padded gauge boxes, so ambiguous glow near the altitude gauge is intentionally left out.
